title: Lawn Surface Detection
description: Classify mowable grass, soil, road, and flowers for automower navigation.
long_description: This project allows you to train a YOLO-based model to identify mowable grass, bare soil, road surfaces, and flowers in an image/video. This model is suitable for autonomous lawn mowers and garden monitoring applications.
